content.text: The data show a clear signature. Before July 2018, Zone F3_Z01's temperature followed a normal diurnal swing. After July 2018, roughly 48% of its readings are pinned at exactly 24.0/23.999 °C in flat runs up to 16 hours long — a value identical to the zone's cooling setpoint, consistent with a frozen/stuck sensor reading rather than physical air temperature. Other zones show normal smooth diurnal cycles (no such flat plateau), and there is no corresponding load/usage stream to support "local load change." This is a sensor fault.
